numberPattern.title: Order number pattern
numberPattern.description: Your order numbers from {prefix}, {year}, {month}, {number} and {suffix}, with letters, digits, - and _ between them: {number} once, {month} only with {year}. The number starts again each month with {month}, each year with {year}, by your business time zone (SH-001043 from {prefix}{number}; SH-2026-0043 from {prefix}{year}-{number}; 202603-0043 from {year}{month}-{number}). A pattern that breaks these rules reads as {prefix}{number}.

numberPrefix.title: Order number prefix
numberPrefix.description: What {prefix} stands for in the order number pattern (for example SH-): letters, digits, - and _ (other characters are left out, as order numbers go in addresses).

numberSuffix.title: Order number suffix
numberSuffix.description: What {suffix} stands for in the order number pattern: letters, digits, - and _ (other characters are left out).

messageChannels.title: Order messages by
messageChannels.description: How shoppers get order messages, through Notifications.

returnsAccepted.title: Returns without the Returns feature
returnsAccepted.description: What search engines are told about returns while the Returns feature is off: nothing, or that you take no returns. With Returns on, its return window says it.

paymentWindowMinutes.title: Time to pay (minutes)
paymentWindowMinutes.description: An order paid online or by bank transfer (or a cash-on-delivery advance) that is not paid within this time is canceled and its stock given back; the online checkout at Payments ends with it (at least 30 minutes after it starts, and within the gateway's longest). 0 = never canceled.

confirmationHours.title: Time to confirm (hours)
confirmationHours.description: A cash-on-delivery or pay-at-pickup order your staff do not confirm within this time is canceled and its stock given back. 0 = never canceled.

addressRequired.title: Required address fields
addressRequired.description: Besides the name (and the phone while a phone number is needed). Leave out the city for one free-text address. Each country's address format adds what it needs (a state and ZIP code in the US, a province and postal code in Canada, no postal code where a country has none), in its own order and with its own labels. An address without a country is in your business.json country.

phoneRequired.title: Phone number needed
phoneRequired.description: On: every delivery address and every guest gives a phone number. Off: they may leave it out (guests who check out by phone still give theirs).

guests.title: Guest checkout
guests.description: Off: shoppers must sign in to order. On: anyone can order with a name and contact details. Unless password: someone whose phone or email already has a password account must sign in.

guestIdentity.title: Guests check out by
guestIdentity.description: What a guest gives and is known by: one customer record per phone number, per email address, or either (the phone when given, else the email address). A guest's orders move into their account when they sign in with that phone or email address verified.

defaultCallingCode.title: Default calling code
defaultCallingCode.description: For phones typed without a country code (guests, alerts, delivery addresses), for example +44 or +1. Empty: the calling code of the country in business.json; without one, numbers must start with + or 00.

trunkPrefix.title: National trunk prefix
trunkPrefix.description: Dropped from national numbers before the calling code is added, for example 0. Empty: the country's usual prefix (0; 8 for +7; none where national numbers keep their 0, as in Italy).

countries.title: Countries of guest and alert phones
countries.description: Only phones with these countries' calling codes may be used to order as a guest or to get alerts; alerts never go to a member's phone of another country. Empty: any country.

customerRecords.title: Customers appear
customerRecords.description: First order: a customer record is made with their first order (or when staff open an Accounts user). Sign in: also as soon as a signed-in shopper uses the shop, before any order.

successUrl.title: Order placed page address
successUrl.description: Where shoppers land after they place or pay for an order; {number} and {id} fill in the order. Empty: they stay on the page they ordered from.

cancelUrl.title: Payment canceled page address
cancelUrl.description: Where shoppers land when they leave a payment without paying; {number} and {id} fill in the order. Empty: the same page as above.

editPricing.title: Staff edits of waiting orders
editPricing.description: Reprice: an edited order is priced again (its offers as placed, its delivery fee and cash handling fee worked out anew). Keep placed amounts: it keeps the offer discount, delivery fee and payment fee it was placed with (the discount at most what the items come to).

deleteGivesBack.title: Deleting an order gives back
deleteGivesBack.description: Held: what an order not delivered yet holds (stock, offer uses, redeemed points). All: also the items, offer uses and points of a delivered or closed order (its stock back, earned points taken back, redeemed points given back).

numberDigits.title: Order number digits
numberDigits.description: The fewest digits of {number} (zeros in front; it grows past them when it must): SH-001043 has 6, SH-2026-0043 has 4.

statusTemplates.title: Status messages
statusTemplates.description: One: one template for every status. Per status: ecommerce.order_status.<status key> per status.

orderUrl.title: Order page address
orderUrl.description: The page where a shopper sees their order, linked from order messages, for example https://example.com/orders/{number}.

reviewUrl.title: Review page address
reviewUrl.description: The page where a shopper writes a review, linked from messages; {number} fills in the order number.
